title: Networking
tagline: The network basics Kubernetes builds on
description: Plain-English networking fundamentals: addresses and ports, TCP and UDP, DNS, HTTP, TLS and proxies, each tied back to where it shows up in Kubernetes.

competencies.text: Explain IP addresses, packets, ports, NAT and firewalls
Compare TCP and UDP and reason about latency
Explain domain names, DNS lookups and caching
Read HTTP requests, responses and status codes
Explain TLS, proxies and load balancing
